Tuning autovacuum

Postgres keeps every row version in the heap until vacuum removes it. This article explains how the visibility map works, why autovacuum falls behind on busy tables, and which settings you should tune first when the table keeps growing. We look at real numbers from a production cluster and show the queries we used to find the problem.
